title: What is Democracy? Why Democracy?
subtitle: Understanding the core of democratic governance
subject: Civics
author: Shine Academy EduOS AI
learning_outcomes: Define democracy and differentiate it from other forms of government.
Understand the key features of a democratic government.
Analyze the arguments for and against democracy.
Appreciate the broader meaning of democracy in social and everyday life.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the concept, features, pros, and cons of democracy, applying its principles to real-world scenarios.
common_misconceptions: Democracy is only about voting in elections.
Any government that holds elections is a true democracy.
Democracy always results in the best economic outcomes.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student struggles with evaluating a non-democratic country masquerading as democratic, ask them to check if the elections were truly free and fair and if the rulers have real decision-making power.
